blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations’ (Asean) parliamentary grouping formally admitted Timor-Leste as its 11th member on Wednesday. The international organization welcomed Timor-Leste into the assembly a year after it became a member of the regional bloc. Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez said Timor-Leste’s ascension as member of the Asean Inter-parliamentary Assembly (AIPA) would allow Asia’s youngest nation greater political and economic access to regional neighbors. “It’s very historical,” Hernandez, head of the Philippines’ delegation to AIPA, said in a media briefing.
